examples.translation: The weather is extremely cold today.

title: 如果……(的话), 就…… (if …, then…)
longExplanation: if …, then…. Pinyin: rúguǒ……( dehuà), jiù……

examples.sentence: 如果你太累的话，就休息一会儿。
examples.romanization: rúguǒ nǐ tài lèi dehuà， jiù xiūxi yīhuìr。
examples.translation: If you are too tired, take a break.

title: A + 得 + CLAUSE (so A that + CLAUSE)
longExplanation: so A that + CLAUSE. Pinyin: A + dé + CLAUSE

examples.sentence: 儿子累得下了班就睡觉了。
examples.romanization: érzi lèi dé xià le bān jiù shuìjiào le。
examples.translation: The son was so tired that he went to sleep as soon as he got off work.

title: A + A + 的 (A (with characteristics))
longExplanation: A (with characteristics). Pinyin: A + A + de

examples.sentence: 她鼻子小小的，头发黑黑的。
examples.romanization: tā bízi xiǎoxiǎo de， tóufa hēi hēi de。
examples.translation: Her nose is teeny tiny and her hair is black.

title: V + V (V for a bit)
longExplanation: V for a bit. Pinyin: V + V

examples.sentence: 我带你去医院检查检查吧。
examples.romanization: wǒ dài nǐ qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá jiǎnchá ba。
examples.translation: Let me take you to the hospital for to check up a bit.

examples.romanization: xiǎo gāng shénme dōu xǐhuan chī。
examples.translation: Xiao Gang likes to eat anything (lit. whatever).

title: 只要……就…… (as long as)
longExplanation: as long as. Pinyin: zhǐyào…… jiù……

examples.sentence: 只要我有时间，就一定跟你去旅游。
examples.romanization: zhǐyào wǒ yǒu shíjiān， jiù yīdìng gēn nǐ qù lǚyóu。
examples.translation: As long as I have time, I will definitely travel with you.

examples.sentence: 关于这件事，我们还没有决定呢。
examples.romanization: guānyú zhè jiàn shì， wǒmen hái méiyǒu juédìng ne。
examples.translation: We have not decided on this matter yet.

longExplanation: V and produce an outcome. Pinyin: V + chūlái

examples.romanization: zhège zì nǐ néng xiě chūlái ma?

longExplanation: V and recognize. Pinyin: V + chūlái

examples.sentence: 你听出来了吗？这是谁的声音？
examples.romanization: nǐ tīng chūlái le ma？ zhè shì shéi de shēngyīn？
examples.translation: After listening, did you recognize [it]? Whose voice is this?

examples.sentence: 我真希望时间能慢下来。
examples.romanization: wǒ zhēn xīwàng shíjiān néng màn xiàlai。
examples.translation: I really hope that time can slow down.

examples.sentence: 我想不起来他的名字了。
examples.romanization: wǒ xiǎng bù qilai tā de míngzi le。
examples.translation: I can't think of (lit. think up) his name.

examples.sentence: 他看上去/看起来像40多岁。
